name: ibis Riga Centre
desc: Perfectly located in the heart of Riga, the Ibis Riga Centre Hotel combines historic charm with modern comfort. Just 90 meters from Riga Central Station, it is ideal for guests arriving by train or exploring the city's landmarks on foot. Built in 1895 by Latvian architect Karl Johan Felsko, the building has stood for over a century as a welcoming symbol of hospitality for travelers from around the world.
